name: @jeswr/solid-recipe
description: Generated schema.org recipes, meal plans, importers and ingredient scaling.

scripts.build: pnpm -w exec tsc -p packages/solid-recipe/tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-generated.mjs
scripts.codegen: node node_modules/@jeswr/federation-codegen/dist/cli.js gen --ontology codegen/recipe.ontology.ttl --shapes codegen/recipe.shapes.ttl --config codegen.config.json --out src/generated
